# Attachment deletion confirmation and completion depend on the actual caller contract

AttachmentInfo.deleteAttachments defaults silent to true and asks for confirmation only when silent is false. Its current parameter description says the reverse. The UI multiple-delete caller passes false, while the extension caller omits the argument and awaits completion after validating attachment parts. The module awaits message stripping, replacement copy, original deletion, and folder update in order. UI dispatch does not await these promises, and a synchronous try/catch around dispatch is not evidence of handling a later rejection. Keep confirmation, asynchronous completion, and UI error handling separate. No file, message or UI operation ran.

Scope: mail AttachmentInfo deletion API.
